summary: Indaptus Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an amended and restated at-the-market offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright, replacing the prior June 2022 agreement. The new ATM facility allows sales of common stock up to $100 million aggregate offering price, subject to share authorization and Form S-3 eligibility. Sales are at prevailing market prices through the agent on a commercially reasonable efforts basis, with company-designated daily caps and minimum price. A prospectus supplement was filed. This routine equity financing facility is not a special situation; no deal terms, premiums, or strategic changes apply. Watch for periodic takedown disclosures and dilution impact.
